response.sql: WITH per_rating AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_price_per_day FROM film WHERE rating IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rating), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_price_per_day) AS across_rating_avg FROM per_rating) SELECT AVG(p.avg_price_per_day) AS avg_price_per_day, AVG(p.avg_price_per_day - b.across_rating_avg) AS avg_amount_above FROM per_rating AS p CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_price_per_day > b.across_rating_avg;

assumptions.assumption: Each rating has equal weight in the across-rating average. The request specifies averaging the per-rating figures, so this is resolved.
